subject: Re: Post-close MAP — staged deployment and canary cadence for Peregrine Labs
messages:
From: Tom Reeves <tom.reeves@peregrine-labs.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@peregrine-labs.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-close MAP kickoff: deployment windows and canary cadence

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning — Peregrine's execs are aligned and eager to confirm next steps. To lock the mutual action plan and get the downstream teams moving, can you lay out a compact post-signature plan that embeds:

- a canary window cadence (duration, traffic split, acceptance gates)
- migration approach for our primary 3 services (auth, search, recommendations)
- training windows for ops and product support teams
- rollback criteria and runbook ownership

We have an internal deadline to start staging on 2027-09-06 and would love to keep the first canary the week of 2027-09-13 if that's doable. Attached is a short list of ops questions from our infra lead.

Attachments: initial-ops-questions.docx (summary of infra constraints)

Can you cc the implementation leads and share a draft MAP spreadsheet we can iterate on?

Thanks,
Tom Reeves
Head of Platform Integrations
Peregrine Labs
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reeves <tom.reeves@peregrine-labs.com>
Cc: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@peregrine-labs.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Aug 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-close MAP kickoff: deployment windows and canary cadence

Hi Tom / Alyssa,

Appreciate the clear ask — drafting a compact MAP and embedding the implementation plan makes sense. I attached a working MAP (peregrine-map-v1.xlsx) and a short PDF canary-checklist with acceptance gates. High level proposal below — I kept it tight so you can present to your stakeholders:

Phase A — Staging (2027-09-06 to 2027-09-12)
- Provision dedicated staging cluster (isolated VPC)
- Smoke load: synthetic tests + subset of replay traffic (10%)
- Signoff: staging acceptance checklist (attached)

Phase B — Canary 1 (2027-09-13 to 2027-09-19)
- Traffic split: 2% live traffic routed to Redwood canary variant
- Duration: 7 days with hourly health checks and token-level latency metrics
- Acceptance gates: error rate <0.3%, p95 latency <= 220ms, no data leakage alerts

Phase C — Expanded Canary (2027-09-20 to 2027-09-26)
- Traffic ramp to 10% with automated fallback to previous model variant
- Runbook triggers: immediate rollback on sustained 3-minute error spike above gate

Phase D — Migration & Training (2027-09-27 to 2027-10-07)
- Cutover strategy: blue-green for recommendations, gradual cutover for search + auth
- Training: two 90-minute sessions (ops runbook + incident playbook) — see training-windows-availability.csv attached
- Post-cutover validation: 48-hour monitoring window, then formal acceptance

Ownership and Contacts
- Redwood on-call: Ben Carter (primary), Marissa Cole (secondary)
- Customer ops lead: Alyssa Chen
- Escalation (SLA exceptions / expedited rollback): Laura Bennett (eng ops)

Open items we need from Peregrine
- Confirmation of staging cluster CIDR and peering window (by 2027-08-24)
- Ops contact for real-time slack bridge during canary (channel + rotation)
- Any restricted data paths for auth flows (list by 2027-08-26)

Attachments: peregrine-map-v1.xlsx, canary-checklist.pdf, training-windows-availability.csv

I also added a short column in the MAP spreadsheet for 'required infra tick' so your infra team can mark dependencies. If the proposed dates work, I'll pull in Laura to finalize the cutover runbook and Ben to draft the on-call rotations.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Sr. Solutions Manager — Redwood Inference
From: Tom Reeves <tom.reeves@peregrine-labs.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@peregrine-labs.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-close MAP kickoff: deployment windows and canary cadence

Neha — this is great, thanks. A couple of quick clarifications from Peregrine infra: 

1) Staging cluster: we can provision the VPC peering on 2027-09-04 (so your staging start date is fine).
2) For Canary 1, can we move the start to 2027-09-14 (Tuesday) to give our SREs an extra day for prep?
3) Rollback criteria: please confirm whether Redwood automation will perform the immediate fallback or if the on-call engineer must manually trigger — we prefer automated fallback for the first ramp if it meets the acceptance gates.

We'll confirm the CIDR and share the Slack channel by COB Monday 2027-08-23. Once we lock the Tuesday start for Canary 1 I'll update our calendar invites.

Tom
Tom Reeves
Head of Platform Integrations
Peregrine Labs
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reeves <tom.reeves@peregrine-labs.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 16:48:00 -0700
Subject: Finalized MAP & cutover cadence (updated runbook annex)

Tom / team — looping in the finalized timeline and the runbook annex. Per Tom's ask we've shifted Canary 1 to start 2027-09-14 (Tuesday). Key updates: 

- Automated fallback: Redwood control plane will perform the automated fallback to the pinned model variant when the canary agent trip conditions are met. Manual override is available via the on-call page.
- On-call window (first canary week): Ben Carter (0700-1500 PST), Marissa Cole (1500-2300 PST), Redwood eng escalation: Laura Bennett (2300-0700 PST)
- DocuSign link for final MAP acceptance: https://app.redwood.com/rollouts/DEAL-PL-2027-031/accept

Attachments included here: peregrine-map-v1.xlsx (final v1), canary-checklist.pdf (with gating thresholds), training-windows-availability.csv

Please confirm acceptance of the dates and the automated rollback behavior by EOD Wed 2027-08-25 so we can lock infra provisioning and send calendar invites to the training sessions.

Thanks — Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Implementation Operations — Redwood Inference
[Attachment stubs: peregrine-map-v1.xlsx, canary-checklist.pdf, training-windows-availability.csv]
